Grand Theft Auto VI is a 2026 action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. It is the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following Grand Theft Auto V (2013), and the sixteenth entry overall. Set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, and in the fictional city of Vice City, based on Miami, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Players are able to freely roam Leonida's open world.
Preliminary work began in 2014 following the release of Grand Theft Auto V, with principal production starting after the launch of Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2018. Rockstar's global development teams more than doubled since Red Dead Redemption 2. Miami and its surrounding areas were extensively researched for the game's world, which parodies 2020s American culture. The protagonists' dynamic is inspired by the notorious outlaw duo Bonnie and Clyde, and the non-player characters (NPCs) were written to ensure players experience different areas of Vice City.
Following years of speculation and anticipation, Rockstar confirmed in February 2022 that the game was in development. That September, footage from unfinished versions was leaked. Grand Theft Auto VI was formally revealed in December 2023. It became the most preordered video game of all time, with estimated sales exceeding 17 million digital copies, generating over $1.6 billion in revenue prior to launch. Following two delays, further leaks, and an extensive marketing campaign, it was released on 19 November 2026 for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S to universal critical acclaim. It surpassed The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998) to become the highest-rated video game on Metacritic and is the only game from the 21st century to achieve an overall score of 99.
Gameplay
Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player, action-adventure game set within an open world played from a third-person view as either Jason Duval or Lucia Caminos. Players can choose to fight non-player characters (NPCs), steal vehicles, rob establishments or get into high-speed chases with the police.[1][2][3] When roaming freely, players have several options for activities such as skydiving, wrestling, basketball, exercising, kayaking and scuba diving.[4][5][6][7]
Throughout the game, players can gain or lose weight - a returning feature from Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - as both characters, and if the player stays awake as either character for days on end, it will become visible on their faces.[8] The game has a "Criminal Profile" rating system that tracks each player character's reputation based on their actions, similar to the honour system previously used in Red Dead Redemption 2.[9] This system is not meant to portray Lucia and Jason as "do-gooders", but will track whether each character keeps their crimes professional or commits unnecessary violence with in-game consequences that reflect their reputation.[10]

SOURCE rockstarreport.com (GTA 6 Release Date: November 19, 2026 and Full Timeline ...):
The current GTA 6 release date is November 19, 2026.
That is the date Rockstar and Take-Two now list for Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is also the date attached to preorders, preload timing and the latest official launch material.
The simple answer is easy. The history is messier. GTA 6 started as a 2025 game, was later moved to May 26, 2026, then moved again to November 19, 2026. That makes the release date one of the most important things to track during the final stretch of the rollout.
This page follows the official timeline only: Rockstar, Take-Two, store listings and published trailer beats. Rumours, retail placeholders and leaked dates do not count unless Rockstar or Take-Two confirms them.
GTA 6 release date quick facts
- Current release date: November 19, 2026
- Launch platforms: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S
- PC release date: not announced
- Original release window: 2025
- Previous full date: May 26, 2026
- Preorders opened: June 25, 2026
- Digital preload: available since November 10, 2026
- Code-in-box retail availability: from November 12, 2026, with a download code rather than a game disc
For the wider picture around characters, Leonida, trailers, platforms and preorders, start with our GTA 6 everything we know feature. This page is just the release-date record.
GTA 6 release date history
| Date | Official timing | What changed | 
|---|---|---|
| December 4, 2023 | 2025 | Rockstar and Take-Two announced GTA 6 for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S with Trailer 1 and a broad 2025 window. | 
| May 2, 2025 | May 26, 2026 | Take-Two said the game, previously expected in Fall 2025, was now planned for May 26, 2026. | 
| May 6, 2025 | May 26, 2026 | Trailer 2 arrived and Take-Two again described GTA 6 as set to launch May 26, 2026. | 
| November 6, 2025 | November 19, 2026 | Take-Two announced that GTA 6 was now launching November 19, 2026. | 
| June 24-25, 2026 | November 19, 2026 | Rockstar announced preorder timing and launch details, again listing November 19, 2026 as the release date. | 
| August 27, 2026 | November 19, 2026 | Rockstar released GTA VI: An Extended Look and again listed November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X\ | 
| October 15, 2026 | November 19, 2026 | Rockstar released the GTA VI launch trailer and again said the game would arrive November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X\ | 
| November 10, 2026 | November 19, 2026 | Rockstar opened digital preloading for players who preordered on PS5 and Xbox Series X\ | 
That is the official chain so far. GTA 6 went from a broad 2025 window, to a full May 2026 date, to the current November 2026 date.
The current date is November 19, 2026
November 19, 2026 is the date that matters now.
Rockstar's GTA VI site, Take-Two's preorder announcement and the store campaign all point to that date. Rockstar repeated it when the GTA 6 Extended Look went live on August 27, then reaffirmed it with the launch trailer on October 15. It is not a rumour, not a retailer placeholder and not a leaked target. It is the active official date.
The date also sits at the centre of the current buying timeline. Preorders opened in June 2026. Digital preload is now available for players who have preordered: it went live at midnight local time on PlayStation 5 and 12 a.m. GMT worldwide on Xbox Series X|S on November 10. Rockstar says code-in-box versions should be available from retailers beginning November 12, with a download code rather than a game disc.

In the immortal words of Carl "CJ" Johnson from an earlier edition of Grand Theft Auto, "Ah s***, here we go again." After 13 years and two delayed launches, video game fans are finally getting their hands on Grand Theft Auto 6.
GTA, as it's widely known, has evolved since its launch in 1997 into one of the biggest franchises in entertainment and one of the few sure hits in the ferociously competitive video game world. Tens of millions of people globally are expected to pick up their joysticks as Rockstar Games, the company behind the series, rolls out GTA 6 on Nov. 19 in countries around the world.
As fans eagerly await the latest GTA installment, Rockstar has whipped up interest with a series of and even an on Netflix. In typical fashion, however, the company has kept the hype simmering by withholding key information about the game ahead of its official launch this week.
"Having been over a decade since the last full release of a Grand Theft Auto game, all that energy just keeps getting bottled up and bottled up, and people are reading into every tweet and every little piece of news that's coming out of Rockstar to try and glean all the details of this game," Andrew Marok, director of equity research for digital media at financial firm Raymond James, told CBS News.
Here's what to know about the long-awaited release of GTA 6.
What is GTA 6 about?
The latest GTA installment centers on the stories of Lucia Caminos, the game's first-ever female protagonist, and Jason Duval. Jason, who has been working for drug runners, craves a quieter life but keeps getting dragged back into crime, according to Rockstar's synopsis of GTA 6. Lucia, meanwhile, has recently left Leonida Penitentiary, where she landed after "fighting for her family."
When a criminal job goes wrong, the pair become entangled in a wider conspiracy. The series is based in Vice City, inspired by Miami, in the fictional state of Leonida. Rockstar has touted the location as the most detailed version of the game yet, with architecture, beaches, roads and bars all inspired by South Florida.
There's "this concept of GTA 6 being just bigger than the game," Marok said. "It's also about the immersion in the world of Vice City."
What equipment do I need to play the game?
Players will need either a PlayStation5 or Xbox Series X or S console to play GTA 6. Rockstar told players who are preloading the game to plan ahead, as they may need up to 212 GB of storage space, depending on their device.
When can people start playing?
The game officially debuts worldwide on Thursday, Nov. 19. Rather than a single launch time, GTA 6 is rolling out at midnight local time in countries around the world, giving some users access before others. This website shows the countdown time by country.
Pre-orders for the game began back in June. But users weren't allowed to start pre-downloading on their PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles until Nov. 10, according to Rockstar. Gamers were also able to purchase a "code-in-box" version, a physical case that contains a code users can input to download the game from the PlayStation Store or Xbox.
How much does it cost?
Grand Theft Auto 6 costs $79.99 for the "standard edition" and $99.99 for the "ultimate edition." The latter contains an exclusive collection of cars, weapons and apparel.
